```
['create a SawyerMocapBase subclass to initialize a MuJoCo Sawyer robot environment with mocap XYZ control', 'get the end effector position of the Sawyer robot hand from the simulation data', 'compute the center of mass between the left and right gripper fingers of the Sawyer robot', 'save and restore the full simulation state including joint and mocap positions for the Sawyer environment', 'compute a caging reward signal for the Sawyer gripper based on pad positions, object proximity, and gripper effort']
```
